wall-foundation.name: Wall Foundation
wall-foundation.description: Lifts walls, gatehouses, towers and hoardings over uneven ground, and stacks for a bigger rise. Nothing else goes on top. Can't be hit while something stands on it.
wall-foundation.flavor: Even a wall needs a leg up.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: A wall of sharpened logs that blocks the way for everyone.

wall.name: Wall
wall.description: A solid wall of iron-banded planks that blocks the way for everyone.
wall.flavor: Fences are for neighbours. Walls are for everyone else.

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
gatehouse.description: A fortified gate with stairs up to the wall walk. Shuts when enemies or bandits come near.
gatehouse.flavor: Grand enough to welcome guests, sturdy enough not to.

log-hoarding.name: Log Hoarding
log-hoarding.description: A gallery on the wall where warriors roll logs down at enemies, knocking over everyone in their path.
log-hoarding.flavor: "Timber!" is shouted out of courtesy, usually too late.

oil-hoarding.name: Oil Hoarding
oil-hoarding.description: A gallery on the wall where warriors pour boiling canola oil on enemies below.

wall-tower.name: Wall Tower
wall-tower.description: Joins walls on any side and leads up to the wall walk. Sees far through the fog, further from high ground.
wall-tower.flavor: The best view in the district, mostly of trouble.

ballista-tower.name: Ballista Tower
ballista-tower.description: A wall tower with a ballista on its deck. With a crew aboard, it shoots the nearest enemy in reach on its own, with a little extra range from its height.

trebuchet-tower.name: Trebuchet Tower
trebuchet-tower.description: A wall tower with a small trebuchet on its deck. With a crew aboard, it lobs stones at the nearest enemy in reach on its own, far past the wall.
trebuchet-tower.flavor: They can see you coming. So can the rock.

blazer.name: Blazer
blazer.description: A fire basket on a wall, burning pine resin. Archers on the wall within two pieces of it shoot fire arrows at resin puddles. Now and then one gets burned.

resin-puddle.name: Resin Puddle
resin-puddle.description: Pine resin poured on the ground or a road. Archers by a lit Blazer set it alight with fire arrows. It burns for 6 hours and hurts everyone in it, your own too.

field-infirmary.name: Field Infirmary
field-infirmary.description: A healing tub on wheels for after a battle. Once no enemy is in sight, wounded troops take turns lying in it and heal fast while its doses last. A dose is 1 extract and 2 berries. Its crew only moves it. Only warriors can build it.
field-infirmary.flavor: The tub's warm. Don't ask what's in it.

field-ladder.name: Field Ladder
field-ladder.description: Lets your warriors and carters climb a one-level step. Only warriors can build it.

field-ramp.name: Field Ramp
field-ramp.description: A long timber ramp up a one-level step for warriors, carters and siege machines. Only warriors can build it.
field-ramp.flavor: Ladders are for beavers. Battering rams need something gentler.

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description: Batters the wall, gate or dam in front of it, faster with more warriors aboard. Only warriors can build it.

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description: Rolls up to a wall and lets the warriors aboard out onto its walk. Only warriors can build it.
siege-tower.flavor: Stairs took beavers to the next level. Siege towers take them to someone else's.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.description: Hurls stones at a chosen target, hurting enemies and battering walls and siege engines. Its crew moves and aims it. Only warriors can build it.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.description: Shoots heavy bolts flat and far: deadly to enemies, weak against walls. Its crew moves and aims it. Only warriors can build it.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.description: Hurls siege stones at a chosen target, hurting enemies and battering walls, gates and siege engines. Needs warriors aboard to turn and throw.
trebuchet.flavor: What goes up must come down. Preferably on them.

weaponsmith.name: Weaponsmith
weaponsmith.description: Makes spears, bows, shields and ballista bolts, plus swords for the Iron Teeth and slings for the Folktails.
weaponsmith.flavor: Every beaver can chew. Only a few can temper steel.

bladesmith.name: Bladesmith
bladesmith.description: Makes swords for warriors and battle axes for berserkers.

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.flavor: Measure the powder twice. Then step back.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains its workers as troops: warriors, spearmen, or the faction's own kind.
barracks.flavor: Beavers were made for chewing, not fighting. These ones chew angrily.

archery-range.name: Archery Range
archery-range.description: Trains its workers to shoot from a distance: archers, or the faction's own kind.
archery-range.flavor: A beaver with a bow is still a beaver. A beaver with a bow and a grudge is an archer.

monastery.name: Monastery
monastery.description: Trains monks. Instead of fighting, they convert enemy troops and siege machines to your side, then wait for their faith to return.

wagon-yard.name: Wagon Yard
wagon-yard.description: Sends supply carts to the front so warriors can eat, drink and build siege engines off the roads.
wagon-yard.flavor: An army marches on its stomach.

small-armory.name: Small Armory
small-armory.flavor: Spears go point up. Someone learned that the hard way.

medium-armory.name: Medium Armory
medium-armory.flavor: Half of any war is knowing where the swords are.

stone-press.name: Stone Press
stone-press.description: Presses scrap metal and logs into siege stones for catapults and trebuchets.

mine-workshop.name: Mine Workshop
mine-workshop.description: Makes water mines from explosives and metal blocks.
mine-workshop.flavor: Workers here are paid extra and asked to sneeze outside.

mine-slipway.name: Mine Slipway
mine-slipway.description: Releases floating mines that drift with the current and explode against the first building they hit.
mine-slipway.flavor: Rivers have always carried gifts downstream. Not always nice ones.

moored-mine.name: Moored Mine
moored-mine.description: A mine anchored in the water. Goes off when a boat or a drifting mine comes close.
moored-mine.flavor: Out of sight, out of mind, out of boat.

fireship-dock.name: Fireship Dock
fireship-dock.description: Launches boats packed with explosives that sail up the river and blow up against the first building or mine they hit.

mine-net.name: Mine Net
mine-net.description: Floats in the river and catches drifting mines. Lay several end to end to make a barrier.
mine-net.flavor: The catch of the day, handled very gently.

net-winch.name: Net Winch
net-winch.description: Its worker rows out to the linked nets and brings back caught mines for reuse.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Claims the land around it while its brazier burns, so other players can't build there. Reaches further from high ground. Sends an automation signal while enemy troops are on its land.
watchtower.flavor: From up here, it all looks like ours.

power-exchange.name: Power Exchange
power-exchange.description: Sells power from one district's network to the district across the border.

trading-post.name: Trading Post
trading-post.description: Trades goods with the district across the border at a fixed rate.
trading-post.flavor: A fair price is whatever both sides of the river agree on.

toll-tube-station.name: Toll Tube Station
toll-tube-station.description: Lets your beavers ride another district's tubeway for a toll.

toll-station.name: Toll Station
toll-station.description: Lets your beavers ride another district's ziplines for a toll.
toll-station.flavor: Mind the gap, pay the beaver.

troops-counter.name: Troops Counter
troops-counter.description: Counts your troops that are ready, in training, deployed, fighting or wounded. In district mode, it counts the troops of the district's barracks and ranges, wherever they are.
